buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: A slight edge to Sierra on freshness. Monnet has logged 71 games across 3 matches in 14 days, Sierra only 22 across 1. In the past week Monnet has played 2 matches, Sierra 1.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: No clear edge on motivation and pressure: two factors pull in opposite directions. Monnet is on the way up (+70 Elo over 90 days) while Sierra has been sliding (-64). Sierra is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: No clear edge on conditions: two factors pull in opposite directions. Monnet has 16 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Sierra only 9, so the adjustment period is shorter. On Clay, Sierra has won 60% over the past year (20 matches) to Monnet's 54% (39).

downsides: Elo trend -64 over 90 days vs +70 for Monnet

p2.name: Carole Monnet
upsides: 16 matches on Clay in 90 days vs 9
60% wins in the last 10 matches vs 50%

bottom_line: The model leans Sierra at 55%; agreement across the three signals is 56/100 (mixed signals). The main risk: Monnet is rising (+70 Elo in 90 days) while Sierra slides (-64) and is more recently settled on Clay (16 vs 9 matches in 90 days).
